facts.fact: The 2026 Red Brick Warehouse market runs November 20–December 25; opening day 17:00–21:00, November 21–December 4 11:00–21:00, December 5–25 11:00–22:00. Standard admission starts at ¥500 and is ¥1,000 on listed peak dates; food/retail extra. Online standard tickets do not bypass the normal queue. Sales began November 6 at noon Japan time. Some areas are free; severe-weather closure possible.
